title: Validation: Stevens — 2 layers broken
body:
The scheduled county validation for Stevens, WA found broken layers (run 2026-11-18T21:35:36.788Z).

- Run: https://github.com/cole793/AcresX/actions/runs/44401658417

- Every run: https://github.com/cole793/AcresX/tree/validation-results/history

## Broken layers

| Layer | Parcels broken | Why it alerts | Parcel | Status | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Zoning | 4 of 12 | broken for 4 of 12 parcels in this run | 8974701 | mismatch | zoning.code: expected "RA-5", got null |
|  |  |  | 0763202 | mismatch | zoning.code: expected "R-1", got null |
|  |  |  | 0231200 | mismatch | zoning.code: expected "R1", got null |
|  |  |  | 0000500 | mismatch | zoning.code: expected "C-2", got null |
| Assessment | 3 of 12 | broken for 3 of 12 parcels in this run | 8974701 | mismatch | assessment.propertyClass: expected "99", got null |
|  |  |  | 0763202 | error | Stevens County Assessor timed out |
|  |  |  | 0231200 | mismatch | assessment.propertyClass: expected "11", got null |

Also failing, below the alert threshold or waiting for a second run:

- Public water/sewer: 2 of 12 (8974701, 0000500)
- Zoning rules: 2 of 12 (8974701, 0763202)

Alert rule: a layer alerts when it is broken (error or mismatch) for at least 3 parcels in one run, or when it meets the threshold (3 parcels, or any parcel for the parcel lookup) in two consecutive runs. This issue closes when no layer meets the threshold.
